map.收获损失率评估器 使用指南: Harvest Loss Rate Assessor User Guide
map.收获损失率评估器，评估机器或人工收获损失率、分析损失来源并给出优化建议，提升粮食: Harvest loss rate assessor: evaluate machine or manual harvest loss rate, analyse loss sources and give optimization suggestions to raise the grain recovery rate.
map.总损失 = 理论产量 − 实际收获量；损失率 = 总损失 ÷ 理论产量 × 10: Total loss = theoretical yield - actual harvested amount; loss rate = total loss / theoretical yield x 100%; share of each stage = loss at that stage / theoretical yield x 100%
map.总损失率由理论产量与实际收获量之差计算。另按割台/掉穗、脱粒/清选、夹带/抛撒、: The total loss rate is computed from the difference between theoretical yield and actual harvested amount. In addition, the four stages of header/ear drop, threshing/cleaning, entrainment/scatter and transport/storage are summed into a 'stage loss rate' for cross-checking. A loss rate <=3% is very low, <=5% normal, <=8% high and >8% severe; when a stage exceeds the threshold, corresponding adjustment suggestions are given (header height, drum speed, cleaning air volume and so on).
map.损失率 = 落粒+漏割+清选损失 / 实测可收总量 × 100%。: Loss rate = shatter loss + missed cutting + cleaning loss / measured harvestable total x 100%.
map.按国标方法多点取样。: Sample at multiple points by the national standard method.
map.用于机械调整与作业质量验收。: For machine adjustment and work quality acceptance.
map.：样框内落粒+夹带 22 g，对应可收 700 g，样点损失 3.1%。全田 1: : Shatter plus entrainment in the sample frame is 22 g against a harvestable 700 g, a sample point loss of 3.1%. The 15-point whole-field mean is 2.8%, better than the rice machine harvest standard of <=3.5%, but the missed-cutting component is high, which indicates the header divider needs adjustment.
map.总损失怎么拆？: How is total loss broken down?
map.分落粒（脱不净/抛洒）、漏割（分禾器漏株）、夹带（清选吹出）、破碎。定位最大分项: Split into shatter loss (threshing loss/spillage), missed cutting (divider misses), entrainment (blown out in cleaning) and breakage. Only by locating the largest component can you adjust the machine correctly.
map.为什么验收要多点？: Why take multiple points for acceptance?
map.地头转弯、倒伏区、正常区损失差异大。单点易误判，按标准布点取均值才代表整田作业质: Headland turns, lodged areas and normal areas differ greatly in loss. A single point is easy to misjudge; take the mean over standard sampling points to represent whole-field work quality.
